tools.description: Obtains an RFC 3161 timestamp token for a SHA-256 hash from a public timestamp authority and stores it, so the hash can be shown to have existed at that time. Only the hash is sent: Proofestry never sees the content. Returns the token (verifiable with `openssl ts -verify`) and a record id. A timesta

tools.name: verify_timestamp
tools.description: Free. Re-checks a stored timestamp: the authority's signature over the token, that it covers the recorded hash, and optionally that a hash you supply matches. Lists each check with its result; the authority's certificate chain is not evaluated against a trust list. MCP tool: `verify_timestamp`.

tools.name: snapshot_citation
tools.description: Fetches a public web page and records what it served: the final URL, the time, the HTTP status, the content type, the SHA-256 of the bytes and the title. The record is timestamped (RFC 3161) and gets a permanent proof link. Proofestry does not store the page; set `include_content` to get the bytes b

tools.name: snapshot_citations
tools.description: Like `snapshot_citation` for one to five URLs in a single call, fetched in parallel. All or nothing: if any URL fails, the call fails and nothing is charged. Price: 0.075 USDC per batch. MCP tool: `snapshot_citations`.

tools.name: verify_snapshot
tools.description: Free. Re-checks a stored snapshot: that its fields still hash to the timestamped record, the timestamp authority's signature, and optionally that a content hash you supply is the recorded one. MCP tool: `verify_snapshot`.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: snapshot_citation · Private data: scan_metadata, detect_provenance, mark_content, clean_metadata, scan_file, verify_provenance, compliance_report, timestamp, verify_timestamp, snapshot_citation, verify_snapshot · Public sink: mark_content, clean_metadata · Destructive: scan_metadata.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: snapshot_citation · Private data: scan_metadata, detect_provenance, mark_content, clean_metadata, scan_file, verify_provenance, compliance_report, timestamp, verify_timestamp, snapshot_citation, verify_snapshot · Public sink: mark_content, clean_metadata · Destructive: scan_metadata

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
